arms.A: CANONICAL_ADDITIVE_BM25: exact production retrieve_repository_text_documents_by_bm25, defaults and full bound
arms.B: TRUE_BM25F: canonical field observations; per-field normalized tf, positive field weights, one union IDF and one saturation

bm25f_formula.arithmetic: Python float, fixed grouping and field/query order; every floating input/intermediate/output serialized as float.hex; do not regroup native A channels.
bm25f_formula.combined_tf: sum(field_weight_f * normalized_tf_f) in CONTENT then FILENAME order
bm25f_formula.df_union: Count each eligible resource document once if t occurs in CONTENT OR FILENAME; never twice.
bm25f_formula.document_score: sum term_score in distinct canonical query encounter order; every query multiplier = 1.0
bm25f_formula.empty_field: If tf=0 normalized tf=0. If average=0 all field lengths/tfs must be zero: disclosed denominator=1 convention with zero contribution. No division by zero. Zero-length document in nonempty field may have denominator=0 when synthetic b=1, but tf=0 still contributes zero.

boundary: Only document-field combination architecture changes. No query weights, identifiers/subtokens, path/symbol/AST/graph fields, expansion, reranking, fusion, routing, reformulation, sequential search, software feature or production implementation.
burden_accounting: Calculate every reviewed witness independently; TASK_BACKED units have no retrieval rank; honor encoded repository support choices, never mix witnesses. Choose minimum complete depth then stable reviewed identity; incomplete None. Union selected owning-obligation prefixes for unique resources and exact UTF-8 bytes, retain repeated occurrences and own obligation-relative labels. No task-global ranking.
candidate_invariants: Same normalized queries and exact field tokens
Full positive CONTENT OR FILENAME union independently observed in A and B
No candidates added/lost; mismatch contract defect, no post-hoc union repair
cost_accounting: Future exactly-once run: shared frame/content index/field observation acquisition charged equally to A/B once. Native A retrieval (including its native filename construction) and B union statistics/scoring/sort/trace timed separately at top-level. Whole-task reference cost separate and unchanged. Disclosure includes setup, scoring, memory/index size where observed; publication/durability/wall/child timers descriptive and never double-counted. No cost threshold chooses effectiveness.

decision_rule.complementary_bounds: All baseline-complete obligations remain complete; every reached REQUIRED cell retained. Each depth: 5*B <= 6*A AND B-A <= 5. Each REQUIRED rank: 5*B <= 6*A AND B-A <= 10.
contract_checks: Exact source ancestry and frame/content/document joins
Exactly-once prospective execution with no tuning
Complete clean treatment-blind primary gold and no unresolved cells
decision_rule.meaningful_required_rank: A and B reached; A_rank - B_rank >= 2 AND 5*B_rank <= 4*A_rank
decision_rule.meaningful_witness: A incomplete and B complete OR A_depth > 0 AND 5*B_depth <= 4*A_depth
precedence: Field/DF/normalization/aggregation/application defect or REQUIRED reach loss => BM25F_IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT
Meaningful witness gain AND strong safety AND strong burden => TRUE_BM25F_SUPPORTED
Meaningful witness gain OR meaningful REQUIRED rank gain, WITH all complementary bounds => COMPLEMENTARY_BM25F_VALUE
Completion loss or unbounded REQUIRED regression => BM25F_HARMFUL
decision_rule.primary: B true BM25F versus A canonical additive only; never select an explanatory counterfactual as an arm
decision_rule.strong_burden: Positive baseline and (10*B_unique <= 9*A_unique OR 10*B_occurrences <= 9*A_occurrences), with B_unique <= A_unique AND B_occurrences <= A_occurrences AND B_bytes <= A_bytes.
decision_rule.strong_safety: No selected mandatory baseline-complete witness depth regression, no baseline-reached REQUIRED-cell rank regression, no REQUIRED resource/cell/repository-supported-unit reach loss.
decision_rule.zero_depth: Fully task-backed complete witness depth=0 allowed; 0->0 not meaningful; incomplete represented None, never fabricated rank.

diagnostic_attribution: Fixed per-term telescoping: replace independent field IDFs with union IDF, move positive filename weight inside otherwise independent saturation, then combine into one saturation. Retain native channel grouping residual. Field normalization inputs identical to A; trace exact lengths/averages. Counterfactual calculations are unranked explanations, not additional arms; harmful causes require necessary-evidence/overtaker consequences, allow ambiguity and interacting causes.
execution_policy: No Stage B entry point at this checkpoint. Maintainer reviews frozen Stage A; only after authorization execute A/B and reference prospectively exactly once. Synthetic controlled fixtures are segregated and cannot use the prospective frame.

failure_definitions.BM25F_AGGREGATION_DEFECT: Evidence is not aggregated before a single saturation.
failure_definitions.BM25F_APPLICATION_DEFECT: Term/document score, tie or lossless provenance does not reconstruct.
failure_definitions.BM25F_DF_DEFECT: Union document frequency incorrect or double-counts a document.
failure_definitions.BM25F_FIELD_DEFINITION_DEFECT: Admitted text/lengths differ from sealed canonical representations.
failure_definitions.BM25F_NORMALIZATION_DEFECT: Per-field normalization cannot reconstruct from exact observations/averages/b.
failure_definitions.CONTENT_FIELD_DOMINANCE: Content influence leaves necessary filename evidence behind with captured contribution/overtaker proof.
failure_definitions.CROSS_FIELD_SATURATION_HARM: Fixed-order single-saturation delta contributes to necessary-rank/completion harm; signed score movement alone is insufficient.
failure_definitions.EXPERIMENTAL_CONTRACT_DEFECT: Identity/query/token/candidate/blindness/execution/authoritative gold/reference contract broken; no effectiveness inference.
failure_definitions.FIELD_REPRESENTATION_LIMIT: Unchanged existing fields cannot represent/discriminate necessary fact; no structural/graph claim.
failure_definitions.FILENAME_FIELD_OVERWEIGHT: Filename influence promotes non-required overtakers with proven necessary-evidence consequence, not mere upward movement.
failure_definitions.QUERY_AUTHORING_LIMIT: Necessary fact omitted from frozen query; cannot be repaired by field scoring.
failure_definitions.REQUIRED_RANKING_REGRESSION: Baseline-reached necessary cell or selected completion worsens; exact magnitude and bounds retained.
failure_definitions.UNION_IDF_HARM: Fixed-order union-IDF delta contributes to necessary-rank/completion harm, with exact overtaker evidence.

analysis.text:
Implement strict bounded acquisition for the existing codec-backed filesystem read API.

O1. In `src/devtools/resources/filesystem/reading.py`, replace the complete `read_bytes()` acquisition used by `read()` with bounded chunk acquisition when `max_bytes` is finite. Preserve the public `ResolvedPath`, `file_format`, `max_bytes` and `DEFAULT_MAX_READ_BYTES` contract, including the 16 MiB default, `None` as explicitly unbounded, negative-limit rejection, zero-limit behavior and acceptance at the exact byte boundary. A preliminary stat check may remain, but a growing file must not cause an unbounded read before rejection.

O2. Define the finite acquisition bound precisely: retain at most `max_bytes` payload bytes and acquire at most one additional byte to distinguish exact-boundary EOF from oversized input; bound individual read requests and release the stream on success and every failure. Raise `FileTooLargeError` on excess instead of returning a truncated model. Do not claim a bound on decoded model memory, a stable file snapshot, race-free pathname checks, containment, authorization or locking.

O3. Preserve `resolve_file_format` and `resolve_codec` behavior, explicit format override and suffix inference. Pass complete accepted bytes to the existing codecs without rewriting content. Preserve the concrete `TextFile`, `MarkdownFile`, `CsvFile`, `JsonObjectFile`, `JsonListFile` and `JsonScalarFile` results, UTF-8 decoding, original line endings, encoding and byte-size metadata. Split multibyte input across acquisition chunks without introducing replacement decoding; codec decoding failures remain `TextDecodingError` or the existing format-domain error.

O4. Preserve existing filesystem error boundaries for a missing path, non-regular file, permission denial, unsupported format and oversized input. Normalize permission failures during stream opening and chunk reads to `FilesystemPermissionError` with causal exceptions. Do not change atomic `write()` behavior, format resolution ownership, core path resolution or any Tool authorization boundary; use the existing filesystem package rather than adding a generic streaming framework.

O5. Add controlled tests in `tests/resources/filesystem/test_reading.py` and relevant codec/model tests for empty input, zero/exact/over-limit bytes, negative and unbounded limits, growth after stat, short chunk reads, EOF, stream closure on exceptions, opening/read permission failures, multibyte UTF-8 split across chunks, invalid UTF-8, explicit format overrides and all currently supported rich result types. Demonstrate the finite request/retention bound with deterministic instrumented streams rather than unreliable process-memory measurements or live filesystem races.

O6. Update `src/devtools/resources/filesystem/docs/io.md`, the filesystem overview and roadmap, and public API documentation where needed to describe the acquisition bound and remaining limitations accurately. Preserve existing callers and the protected development validation profile in `docs/development/validation.md`, `scripts/validate_development.py` and `pyproject.toml`; run the protected profile, Ruff, formatting, mypy and diff checks. Do not add binary codecs, new file formats, streaming format parsers, secure filesystem policy or production retrieval changes.

scorer_semantics.CONTENT: RepositoryTextDocument.text: exact decoded whole-resource UTF-8 text, not a window or AST view.
scorer_semantics.FILENAME: PurePosixPath(resource.address.value).stem: final basename without final suffix; no directories, extension field or full path. Canonical iter_lexical_spans on that stem.
scorer_semantics.analysis: Query and both fields: canonical Unicode regex \w+ spans, casefold. Underscores remain inside words; no identifier splitting, stemming or stopwords. Query duplicates retained as observations; distinct terms score once in first encounter order.
scorer_semantics.candidate: Positive native content OR filename term matches; full maximum_results >= N. With positive IDF/settings these are exactly positive-score resources.
scorer_semantics.df: Independent field df counts documents with at least one field occurrence; N is all eligible resource documents in both fields.
scorer_semantics.length: Each field length is its own observation count. Each average is total field length divided by N including zero-length field documents; empty corpus average 0.
scorer_semantics.not_bm25f: Independent field IDFs and independent saturations precede additive channel combination. True BM25F requires combined normalized tf before one saturation and one union IDF.
scorer_semantics.provenance: Native result retains query observations, content statistics/index, independent filename index, both channel scores and every contributing term tf, df, idf, length, average and score.
scorer_semantics.score: sum(content term contributions in distinct query encounter order) + 0.25 * sum(filename term contributions in distinct query encounter order)
scorer_semantics.ties: Descending score, then original native document collection position; full candidate enumeration before result bound.
